label: Fires at GO after a rewarded rare a2->S1 trial, stronger when belief favors S2 and early in episode.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo**2 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (ep_dec**2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_cover ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2)
explanation: Silent at D1 and D2; at GO it is active essentially only when the previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded (indicator alone dev R2 0.28). Its magnitude within that case is graded: larger when the ideal-observer belief still favors S2 (low P(S1 good), i.e. the rare reward is surprising evidence for S1) and decays across the episode (ep_dec), going near zero late. Short form dev 0.60. Free fit adds that the trial before being rewarded raises it, plus small nonlinear belief/time terms (dev 0.64). Residual misses are mostly window-first trials whose previous trial is unknown. No future or model-output variables used.

issues: Every claim held up when I re-scored it on the test split. The last_is('a2 S1 r') indicator alone gives 0.256. Adding belief gives 0.370, adding ep_dec gives 0.482, and with both the recorded short form gives 0.588. Both fitted weights are negative (belief -0.61, ep_dec -0.10), so the activation is larger when belief is low (leaning toward S2) and earlier in the episode, as the label says.
The profile confirms the feature is exactly 0 at D1 and D2. At GO, the residual is +0.305 after a2 S1 r and about -0.015 after every other previous trial.

Small caveat: within the a2 S1 r case the feature looks closer to on/off (about 1.1-1.4 or 0) than smoothly graded. The mean of 0.3 against firing values near 1.2 suggests it fires in only about a quarter of these cases. The linear belief and time terms act as a soft gate. This is still consistent with the label's 'stronger when'.

Misses show no large systematic class. Mean errors by phase x previous trial are all within ±0.012. The worst windows are mostly firings on a window's first trial, where the previous trial is unknown, plus some under-prediction of magnitude late in the episode (for example t45-49 fires about 0.78 where the model predicts 0.15-0.29).

None of the alternatives clearly beat the recorded form on test. belief_lo scored 0.580, ep_trial 0.588 (about the same), (belief_lo<0) 0.577, a reward two trials back 0.572, tv('action',-2)==2 0.494, belief_cover 0.378 and since_rev 0.378. No future or model-output variables are used.
